S.FORM: alang Quzi ga niya mki sku Toweng si atu Hosing Ku, kwara sali buwan nya ga 119 buwan, 294 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 54% kyan ku 158 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 46% kyan ku 136 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, . maki qu ngasal bziran. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Quzi hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay 'zil na Quzi hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkyahu' na Quzi hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkraya' na Quzi hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkyahu' na Quzi hya' ga Balung. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ quzi ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku toweŋ [s|ɕ]i atu ħo[s|ɕ]iŋ ku kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na quzi ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj ʔzil na quzi ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkjaħuʔ na quzi ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkrajaʔ na quzi ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkjaħuʔ na quzi ħjaʔ ɣa βaluŋ reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
